title: Bid Manager – Public Procurement (all genders) in Paris

Today, Dott deploys 200,000 shared vehicles in 400 cities and 17 countries across Europe and the Middle East. The 12 million users have generated over 500 million rides so far. public_posting.title: Bid Manager – Public Procurement (all genders) in Paris
public_posting.richtextDescription:
THIS IS US

Dott is the European champion of shared micromobility. With the mission of moving us closer, Dott facilitates easy urban travel, reduces pollution in cities, and decreases reliance on cars. Today, Dott deploys 200,000 shared vehicles in 400 cities and 17 countries across Europe and the Middle East. The 12 million users have generated over 500 million rides so far. The team is led by CEO Maxim Romain and Executive Chairman Henri Moissinac. For more information, visit www.ridedott.com.

THE ROLE AND YOUR IMPACT AT DOTT

Full-time, permanent and hybrid (3 days/week in the office).

You will be part of the Market Development team. The team is responsible for strengthening and expanding Dott’s footprint across Europe, contributing directly to the company’s growth objectives. You will be at the heart of our market expansion strategy, with a focus on public procurement opportunities. You will shape our approach to these opportunities and deliver competitive bids throughout Europe. This is a global role covering 18 countries, with a primary focus on DACH.

  • Strategic analysis: Work with relevant team members to identify city needs and analyse the competitive landscape; develop and execute action plans to secure wins in top markets.

  • Project management: Lead project teams on complex tenders; identify and prioritize work streams; draw on internal and external resources to deliver on time and to a high standard.

  • Bid writing: Write high-quality bids tailored to each city's context and requirements. Ensure all responses are structured, clear, and compelling. Bid execution is a core part of the role.

  • Stakeholder collaboration: Collaborate with a diverse range of stakeholders (e.g., product, commercial, hardware) to gather input and deliver competitive bids.

YOU’LL FIT GREAT WITH THESE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience: 2–4 years managing tenders (public procurement). Experience in micro-mobility tenders is a plus.

  • Skills:

    • Proven ability to manage complex projects autonomously.

    • Highly detail-oriented, with a track record of delivering high-quality work.

    • Strong problem-solving skills.

    • Structured and compelling writing skills in German and English.

    • Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage diverse stakeholders effectively.

    • Proactive, can-do attitude and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

    • Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Google Docs and Google Slides.

  • Language: Fluent in German and English. Fluency in French is a strong plus.

THIS MAY INSPIRE YOU

  • 🏢 Hybrid work: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home

  • 💻 Our one-time home office bonus upon your start to create your ideal home office setup

  • 📚 Our annual learning & development budget

  • 🛴 Our rides program with availability to opt in and opt out to ride our e-scooters & e-bikes

  • ☀️ Our partnership for mental health at work, with free 1-on-1 video counselling, self-guided development, and more

  • 🌴 Our sabbatical program

  • ⏳ Our flexible hours and 1-month remote working option

  • 🏳️‍🌈 Our diversity and inclusivity initiatives and programs

  • 🎉 Our public holiday swap, with which you can switch two public holidays to another day

  • 🌍 Our voluntary day off for charity work

* benefits may vary depending on country and position

We actively encourage a diverse and inclusive environment that fosters each employee’s individuality at Dott. We take affirmative action to ensure equal opportunity for your application, regardless to your nationality, ethnic or national origin, skin color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, or gender identity. Come as you are and join our ride!

In case you are living with disabilities, chronic illness, or neurodiversity, please inform us, so we can ensure a smooth application process.

If we could spark your interest and you want to change mobility for good with us, apply now and let us know why you’re the one for the job! We encourage everyone to apply and grow with us. Even if you may not tick all the boxes of the requirements, we are happy to hear about the value you can add to the team. We are all learners!

We are looking forward to your application!

At Dott, we respect fundamental privacy rights. We process your personal data in accordance with the requirements of the General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”). For a clear explanation of how we handle and process your personal data, please read our Candidate Privacy Statement.
